lines.text: The LORD reigns, is enthroned above the cherubim, and is great in Zion.
The mighty King loves justice and has exercised justice and righteousness in Egypt.
The psalm calls people to exalt the LORD our God and worship at His footstool.
Moses and Aaron were among His priests, and He spoke to them from the pillar of fire.
He was a forgiving God to them, and the psalm calls people to worship at His holy mountain.
